title: SEC威胁踢出LSU：只因教练想签NFL球员，保护法案能挡住吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Last year at my college sports panel at Power Players, we had athletic directors talking about just signing revenue share agreements with players.
segments.zh: 去年在Power Players的大学体育论坛上，我们请到体育总监讨论与球员签署收入分成协议。

segments.en: A lot has changed since then. So much in one year, there's finally a congressional bill that we will get to.
segments.zh: 自那以后变化很大。一年间变化太多，终于有了一项国会法案，我们稍后会谈到。

segments.en: Today's world of college sports has been called chaotic, the Wild West, and we have two experts here to talk about the landscape of college sports.
segments.zh: 如今的大学体育界被称为混乱、狂野西部，我们有两位专家来讨论大学体育的格局。

segments.en: Thank you, Randy and Candace for joining us.
So all eyes in the college sports world have been on Louisiana State and coach Lane Kiffin and the SEC, your conference Candace.
segments.zh: 大学体育界的所有目光都集中在路易斯安那州立大学、教练Lane Kiffin和SEC，Candace，这是你的联盟。

segments.en: As you all know, Kiffin attempted to bring back players from the NFL to his roster, and the SEC has threatened
segments.zh: 众所周知，Kiffin试图将NFL球员带回他的阵容，而SEC威胁

segments.en: to kick the school out of the conference. That may be resolved now, but it still gives us a lot to talk about.
segments.zh: 将该学校踢出联盟。这可能已经解决，但仍有很多可谈。

segments.en: Randy, what problem does this pose?
Well, I think it highlighted the whole reason you need the Protect College Sports Act, because there's the fundamental issue.
segments.zh: 我认为这凸显了为什么需要《保护大学体育法案》，因为存在根本问题。

segments.en: Are we going to have student athletes or professional athletes?
segments.zh: 我们将有学生运动员还是职业运动员？

segments.en: The wall between the two has broken down.
segments.zh: 两者之间的壁垒已经打破。

segments.en: Very few people who are college athletes become professional, but they come great leaders.
segments.zh: 大学运动员中成为职业选手的很少，但他们往往成为出色的领导者。

segments.en: It's a great training ground. And that's why the concept of student athletes is so important.
segments.zh: 这是一个很好的训练场。这就是为什么学生运动员的概念如此重要。
